description: This file defines the LicenseDao class, which manages database operations related to License entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving by ID or name, listing, counting, and deleting licenses, as well as checking for existing license names.

classes.name: LicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing License entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and license filtering with pagination.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Persists a License entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its unique ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Fetches a License entity matching the given name.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of License entities based on filter parameters, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getLicenseListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object configured with filter and pagination parameters for License listing.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Licenses matching the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple License entities based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks whether a License with the given name exists.

methods.name: getExistingLicenseIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing Licenses from a given list of IDs.
